buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Scope of Supply

Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 7. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 8. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Only Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) or their authorized reseller is eligibl e to participate in the bid. If the bidder is not the OEM, a valid, bid- specific authorizat ion certificate issued by the OEM should be submitted and if the bidder claims to be t he OEM, documentary evidence such as Factory License, Manufacturing Registration Certificate or any other valid proof should be submitted. Without such certificates, th eir bid may not be considered for further evaluation. 2. The Bidder or its OEM (themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, m anufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State G ovt Organization/PSU / Public Listed Company for 5 years before the bid opening date . 3 Copies of relevant contracts (Purchase Order) of similar or same category product s to be submitted along with this bid. 3. Bidder should submit at least 3 Client Satisfactory Performance/CRAC Letters of si milar or same goods/equipment's along with the Bid. 4. The product catalogue/brochure of the equipment should be submitted along with the technical bid.

5. The product quoted must come with a 1-year warranty, effective from the date of i nstallation. The bidder must submit an undertaking on their letterhead regarding the provision of warranty. In absence of such undertaking, the bid will not be considered. 6. The quoted prices should be strictly F.O.R. Destination and inclusive of GST, packi ng, forwarding, freight, unloading, installation, and commissioning at the designated site/location of NIT Patna. 7. Payment will be released only after satisfactory delivery, installation, commissioni ng, demonstration and acceptance of the equipment by the user department and co mpletion of all contractual formalities as per GeM provisions. 8. During the technical evaluation phase, the buyer/ department concerned reserves the right to request a product demonstration (online/offline) from any bidder to verify compliance with the required specifications and assess product quality. The bidder s hould arrange and present the demonstration within five (5) days of receiving such r equest. Failure to comply, will result in the technical rejection of the bid. 9. Bidder/OEM should not have been debarred/blacklisted by any State Government / Central Government institution/department for any reasons. In this regard, the bidder /OEM has to submit an affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- or above d uly certified by a notary as per the attached format (Annexure – II). The said affidavit must be issued in favour of this tender. 10. System should be supplied as integrated unit in a ready to use condition. 11. Machine Grade: Industrial Type, working time capacity continuous without stop: 1 00 hrs. (Minimum) 12. The offered printer should not require mandatory account registration with the m anufacturer's website and can be operated without cloud-based user authentication. An undertaking in this regard must be submitted by the bidder/OEM. 13. The software should not have mandatory requirement of cloud connectivity. An u ndertaking in this regard must be submitted by the bidder/OEM. 14. The 3D Printer will be accepted only if it is a standard product of an established manufacturer. The assembled 3D Printer will not be accepted. 15. No End User License Agreement (EULA) or any such certificate declaring the use o f the 3D printer will be provided. Any offer requiring any such document is liable to b e summarily rejected. 16. Lifetime Support shall be provided. An undertaking in this regard must be submit ted by the bidder/OEM. 17. If any information, declaration or document submitted by the bidder is found to b e false, fabricated, misleading or suppressed at any stage of the procurement proces s, the bid shall be liable for rejection and suitable action, as deemed fit, may be initia ted against the bidder in accordance with the provisions of GeM, GFR and other appli cable Government guidelines. 18. The Buyer reserves the right to verify any information or document submitted by the bidder from the issuing authority, OEM or any other appropriate source and may seek any additional document or clarification during the evaluation process. Failure o f the bidder to furnish the required clarification or documents within the stipulated ti me may result in rejection/disqualification. 19. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Bidder has to submit bid security declaration in lie u of EMD as per Annexure – I attached under ATC.
